task.title:house: Ready a room for a householder
task.how:wood: Hold left-click on a tree trunk until it breaks. Any tree gives logs, and four are needed.
task.how:bench: Press E. Turn a log into planks, then set four planks in a square.
task.how:woodpick: Place the workbench and right-click it. Three planks over two sticks. The recipe book can lay out the grid.
task.how:stonepick: Dig down with the wooden pick until it brings up rubble. Three rubble over two sticks, at the workbench.
task.how:torch: Coal Ore is stone with black flecks. Put its coal over a stick, by hand, for four torches. Nothing hostile comes up in torchlight.
task.how:furnace: Set eight rubble in a ring at the workbench. With wood or coal under it, it smelts soft ore and cooks meat.
task.how:iron: Iron Ore has tan flecks and needs a stone pick. Smelt three bars in the Stone Furnace with coal or wood.
task.how:anvil: The workbench makes it from seven iron bars. Metal tools, weapons and armour are made on it.
task.how:ironpick: Made at the anvil, it breaks Gold Ore, Geodes and Hīrak Ore.
task.how:house: Close in a room with a door and a torch, then place a Holder's Bed in it: hide over planks. A householder will come to it.
task.how:idol: A log, 2 plant fiber, 2 jelly from Kinva and a red flower, at the workbench. The chest of a Broken Store may hold one.
task.how:boss1: Lay the likeness on a Vanahar Altar. It slams the ground round it and charges. Paroha come at half strength. Bring food and salves.
task.how:tinker: Vanahar Remains between two iron bars, over planks, at the workbench. It joins two trinkets into one.
task.how:lumenite: Hīrak Ore glows blue in the deep rock, below height 34. It needs an iron pick or better. Three gems complete the task.
task.how:lumpick: Make it at the anvil to break Jalit Ore and Black Glass, which an iron pick cannot.
task.how:lure: Angār drop Ember Dust on sand at night and by lava. Put it with 2 sandstone, a gold bar and raw meat at the workbench.
task.how:boss2: Lay the lure on a Maruhar Altar. It travels under whoever it hunts and comes up beneath them, so keep moving. Kīta come once it is badly hurt.
task.how:emberforge: Ring Maruhar Remains with eight Deep Rock at the workbench. It smelts Jalit Ore, the glowing orange ore near lava.
task.how:cinder: Jalit Ore lies by lava below height 26 and needs a Hīrak Pick. The Maruhar Furnace smelts it. Five bars are needed.
task.how:bell: 2 iron bars, a Hīrak, 2 Shade Flesh and 2 bone, at the anvil. The chest of a Sealed Store may hold one.
task.how:boss3: Lay the bell on a Kankāl Altar. Its pale orbs come slowly, in fans and rings: step sideways between them. Tama come in when it is nearly dead.
task.how:gate1: Black Glass rims lava below height 12 and needs a Hīrak Pick. Seven of it round Kankāl Remains at the anvil. Then place the gate.
task.how:dim1: Step into the gate and stand still until it carries you through. A bedroll in the Hollow marks nothing.
task.how:umbrite: Antar Ore is violet, in Hollow Rock, and needs a Jalit Pick. Smelt five bars in the Maruhar Furnace.
task.how:censer: 2 Antar bars, 3 spore sacs and a Glowing Mushroom, at the anvil. The chest of a Vault in the Hollow may hold one.
task.how:boss4: In the Hollow, lay the smoker on a Guhamāt Altar. Pieces of its cap fall on marked ground, and Kavak form on them. Kill each as it forms.
task.how:voidkiln: Guhamāt Remains go in a ring of eight Hollow Rock at the workbench. It smelts Tala Ore, the teal ore of the Hollow, and Ākās Ore.
task.how:noctrium: Tala Ore lies in the lower half of the Hollow and needs an Antar Pick. The Guhamāt Furnace makes the five bars.
task.how:kite: Salaha in the Hollow drop Moth Dust. With 2 crystal fiber, 3 feathers and a Tala bar it makes the kite, at the workbench.
task.how:boss5: Jīmūt comes to the kite laid on a Jīmūt Altar on the living ground. It circles and stoops and never lands. Bring a bow or a staff.
task.how:gate2: Frame Jīmūt Remains with six Tala bars at the anvil. Place it on clear ground as you placed the first.
task.how:dim2: Stand in the gate until it carries you through. Nothing lies under the edges of the islands: a fall puts you back on the last footing, hurt.
task.how:aether: Ākās Ore is blue, in Island Rock, and needs a Tala Pick. Smelt five bars in the Guhamāt Furnace.
task.how:lens: Sakal on the Islands drop the shards. Three go in the lens with 2 Ākās bars and a pane of glass, at the anvil. An Island Store may hold one.
task.how:boss6: Lay the lens on a Ratan Altar on the Islands. Its beam swings slowly after you: cross it at a run. Sakal come near the end.
task.how:crucible: This furnace smelts Patik Ore. Make it at the workbench from Ratan Remains in a ring of eight Island Rock.
task.how:prism: Patik Ore is pink, in Island Rock, and needs an Ākās Pick. Five bars from the Ratan Furnace.
task.how:slivers: On the eighth night of the moon's round the moon is dark, and Chandasāvak and Ulūk come up. They drop Moon Slivers. Three are needed.
task.how:mask: The Line Frame makes it from 2 Patik bars, 3 Moon Slivers and 2 Shade Flesh. No old store holds one.
task.how:boss7: Kuranga comes only after dark. Lay the mask on its altar then. It charges and slams, and Chandasāvak come partway through.
task.how:eclforge: Eight Black Glass round Kuranga Remains, at the workbench, make the furnace that smelts Gahan Ore.
task.how:eclipse: Gahan Ore glows violet on the bedrock, below height 14, and needs a Patik Pick. Three bars from the Kuranga Furnace.
task.how:key: 3 Gahan bars, a Hīrak Block, 2 Moon Slivers and 2 shards, at the anvil. No old store holds one.
task.how:boss8: Lay the key on a Cairn. It throws glowing stones, slams, turns a beam and moves from place to place. Chandasāvak join it late in the fight.
task.how:end: The crew holds Nihān Remains, the strongest kill there is. No step of the Guide uses them.
task.said:house: Put a holder's bed in a closed room with a door and a light, and one of us will come and hold there.
task.said:idol: Carve a likeness from a log and bind Kinva jelly to it. Put a red flower on it too. Vanahar comes to that.
task.said:boss1: Lay the likeness at the nearest Vanahar Altar and wake it, peopl. Its remains are wanted on this road.
task.said:tinker: Set the Vanahar Remains in a bench between two iron bars. Two worked pieces can be joined on it. Kāru works at that bench.
task.said:lumenite: Go down past the iron into the deep rock for Hīrak. It takes an edge that will cut the next rock.
task.said:lumpick: A Hīrak pick breaks the Jalit ore by the molten rock, and the Black Glass round it.
task.said:lure: Sink a gold bar in sandstone with raw meat and ember dust. Maruhar comes up through the sand to take it.
task.said:boss2: Call Maruhar up with the lure. Its remains make a furnace that works what fire leaves hard. Kammār will have more to sell.
task.said:emberforge: Ring the Maruhar Remains with Deep Rock and put fire to them. That works Jalit, and later the Antar of Under.
task.said:cinder: Five bars of Jalit from the Maruhar Furnace make a pick for the ore of Under.
task.said:bell: Cast an iron bell with Hīrak in its wall, and pack it with Shade Flesh and bone. Kankāl answers it.
task.said:boss3: Ring the bell at a Kankāl Altar. Its remains open the way Under. Posak will come to you then, and Vejja will have more.
task.said:gate1: Framed in Black Glass, the Kankāl Remains open on Under wherever the frame will stand.
task.said:dim1: Go through and bring back the metals of Under. None of us has been through a gate, peopl.
task.said:umbrite: Antar, the ore of Under, works in the Maruhar Furnace. A pick of it breaks Tala.
task.said:censer: Fill an Antar smoker with spore sacs and a glowing cap. Guhamāt comes to the smoke.
task.said:boss4: Burn the smoker at the Guhamāt Altar Under. Its remains make a furnace for Tala, and Kammār will sell Antar then.
task.said:voidkiln: The Guhamāt Remains go in a ring of the rock of Under. That furnace works Tala, and later the Ākās past the second gate.
task.said:noctrium: Tala lies low, Under, and its bars make the frame of a second gate.
task.said:kite: Make a kite of Crystal Fiber, feathers, a Tala bar and moth dust, and fly it from a Jīmūt Altar.
task.said:boss5: Jīmūt comes to the kite in the air over its altar. Its remains make the second gate.
task.said:gate2: Set the Jīmūt Remains in a frame of Tala bars. None of us has a word for where that gate leads.
task.said:dim2: The metal past the second gate is harder than any you have worked yet, peopl.
task.said:aether: Bring back Ākās from past the second gate. A pick of it breaks Patik, the metal with crystal in it.
task.said:lens: Grind a lens of glass in a rim of Ākās and set shards in it. Ratan comes to the light the lens gathers.
task.said:boss6: Focus the lens at the Ratan Altar past the second gate. The next furnace needs Ratan's remains.
task.said:crucible: For Patik, set the Ratan Remains in a ring of rock from past the second gate.
task.said:prism: Work Patik into bars. A pick of it breaks Gahan, the ore at the very bottom of the rock.
task.said:slivers: On Amāvassa the moon is hollow and what was in it comes down. Kill those and bring back three pieces of the moon.
task.said:mask: Make the mask of Patik, with Moon Slivers and Shade Flesh. Kuranga sees whoever wears it, at night.
task.said:boss7: Wear the mask at a Kuranga Altar after dark, and bring its remains for the last furnace.
task.said:eclforge: Black Glass round the Kuranga Remains makes the furnace for Gahan.
task.said:eclipse: Bring up three bars of Gahan. The key to the Cairn is made of them.
task.said:key: Forge the key of Gahan, with a block of Hīrak, Moon Slivers and shards. It opens the Cairn.
task.said:boss8: Open the Cairn with the key and kill what comes up. With Nihān dead, the stones can be lit again.
task.said:end: A great stone is lit while one of us sits at it with a hand on it, until first light. None of us has sat at one, peopl.

realm:enter.1: No sky. The light comes from glowing fungus and crystal.
realm:enter.2: Open air under the edge of every island
country.enter:ocean: Open water runs out from the land, over sand and clay shallows.
country.enter:beach: Sand runs in a strip between the grass and the water.
country.enter:plains: Flocks keep the grass grazed short. A lone oak stands here and there.
country.enter:palewood: Young oaks come up among pale-barked trees over grass and flowers.
country.enter:forest: Under old oaks set close together, fern and mushroom cover the floor.
country.enter:bloomvale: White and blue flowers grow thick in pale turf under blossoming trees.
country.enter:swamp: Mud lies barely over the water. Reeds and low oaks stand in a haze.
country.enter:taiga: Cold pine wood with fern and berry under it. Snow on the high ground.
country.enter:tundra: Snow lies on the grass and ice along the water. The country is flat.
country.enter:desert: Hot sand rises in dunes, with cactus and dry bramble on them.
country.enter:savanna: Tall dry grass, and flat-topped trees far apart.
country.enter:jungle: It is hot and wet. Very tall trees stand over fern.
country.enter:crags: Grass covers the flats of the high stone. The slopes are bare rock.
country.enter:peaks: Nothing grows here. Snow lies over the stone.
country.enter:hollows: Fungus turf covers the floor, under glowing growth and capped stems.
country.enter:hollows_crystal: Spires of azure and violet crystal rise from bare rock.
country.enter:rift: Leaves that give light hang over turf and white and blue flowers.
country.enter:rift_shards: Pale crystal spires rise here, with white flowers between them.
